# Originality ledger

For each capability: what is kept from upstream and why, what changed in the method, which new example shows the change, what evidence says it is better, and what remains inherited. Upstream: [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d131814572224537fb516b8c5d33dd5fa67`. Every change is also visible as a diff from commit `ba831ad` (the unmodified import).

Reusing good upstream code is deliberate. Where a row says "paths only", SumitCraft's contribution to that skill is packaging, portability, a contract and a re-run, not a new method; it is not presented as original work.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| perspective-illusion | The camera rig, timeline, post pass, quality bar and renderers: the method is upstream's and is good. | Per-platform WebGL backend with readback instead of a hard-coded Metal flag; portable work-folder setup; credits a genre instead of one artist; cut-outs excluded pending provenance. | Stills rendered on Linux with the backend recorded. | smoke tested: evidence/perspective-illusion/ | Scene templates and art direction are upstream's. |
| code-loop | The loop contract, jittered multi-sample renderer and the three checks. | Backend selection per OS with --gl/SUMITCRAFT_GL override and readback; a run manifest with versions and backend; --holds for intentional holds so a deliberate pause is not a failure. | A planted broken loop that check_loop must fail, and a declared-hold case. | functionally verified: evidence/code-loop/ | Starters, sampling scheme and thresholds. |

| vox-explainer | Word-timed engine, devices, motion check. | 'Style C' is now the credited editorial-collage preset; presets expose palette, typography, spacing, composition, texture and motion; two provisional alternatives; cross-platform font fallbacks; creator pronouns removed. | Three-preset comparison stills from one scene. | smoke tested: evidence/vox-explainer/ | Engine and device designs. |
